name: Al-Akhdari
contribution: An Arab poet, logician, astronomer and Maliki jurist.

checks.lead: Sayyidi ʻAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣaghīr ibn Muḥammad ibn Sayyidi ʿĀmir al-Akẖḍarī al-Bīsīkrī (Arabic: سيدي عبد الرحمن بن محمد الصغير بن محمد بن سيدي عمرو الأخضري; 1512–1575), better known as Al-Akẖḍari (Arabic: الأخضري), was an Arab poet, logician, astronomer and Maliki jurist.
